overview.text: The Bandy-bandy is a venomous but shy Australian snake with bold black and white rings. Its name comes from the Kattang language of New South Wales.

identification.text: Smooth and glossy, with sharp black and white rings that go all the way round the body.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Eastern Australia: New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia and the Northern Territory.

habitat.text: Many habitats, from desert to rainforest.

diet.text: Other snakes - almost only blind snakes.

recognise.text: Black and white rings all round the body.
